nurseTranscript: So once a day you're gonna change this, wash your hands first,
and if the old bandage is stuck, just wet it with some water so it comes off easy, don't rip it.
Then wash the burn real gently with mild soap and water and pat it dry, no rubbing.
Put a thin layer of the cream on with a clean Q-tip,
then the non-stick pad goes right on the burn, and wrap the gauze roll around it and tape it.
Don't pop any blisters. If it gets redder, starts oozing pus, smells bad, or you get a fever, call us.
